review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Angiopoietin-like proteins: emerging targets for treatment of obesity and related metabolic diseases, PMID:19875897
primary_title: ANGPTL3 stimulates endothelial cell adhesion and migration via integrin alpha vbeta 3 and induces blood vessel formation in vivo
decision_basis: The integrin and angiopoietin-like-protein reviews cite the primary study showing recombinant ANGPTL3 binds alphaVbeta3 and induces alphaVbeta3-dependent endothelial adhesion, migration, integrin-associated Akt/MAPK/FAK signaling, and angiogenesis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve recombinant/secreted ANGPTL3 and C-terminal domain, alphaVbeta3 heterodimer, endothelial/rat-corneal context, and no Tie2 or SCI inference.

review_locator: Beyond the Matrix: The Many Non-ECM Ligands for Integrins, PMCID:PMC5855671; Angiopoietin-like-2: a multifaceted protein with physiological and pathophysiological properties, PMID:25417860
primary_title: Angiopoietin-like protein 2 promotes chronic adipose tissue inflammation and obesity-related systemic insulin resistance; ANGPTL2 Promotes Inflammation via Integrin alpha5beta1 in Chondrocytes
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary studies assigning ANGPTL2 inflammatory and migratory activity to alpha5beta1; recombinant ANGPTL2 activates integrin-dependent endothelial/monocyte inflammation and chondrocyte MAPK/Akt/NF-kB responses, while receptor blockade suppresses the effects.
limitations_preserved: Qualified at alpha5beta1-dependent receptor/function layer; primary studies do not establish purified binary affinity, and the proposed receptor assignment remains context-dependent; no SCI inference.

review_locator: Regulation of immune cell responses by semaphorins, PMCID:PMC4076735; Semaphorin7A: branching beyond axonal guidance and into immunity, PMCID:PMC3966552
primary_title: Semaphorin 7A initiates T-cell-mediated inflammatory responses through alpha1beta1 integrin
decision_basis: The semaphorin reviews cite the primary study showing activated-T-cell SEMA7A directly interacts with alpha1beta1 at the immunological synapse, stimulates monocyte/macrophage cytokine production, and is required for inflammatory effector responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve GPI-anchored/membrane SEMA7A, alpha1beta1 immunological-synapse topology, immune and EAE context, and no SCI or universal intracellular relay inference.

review_locator: Semaphorin7A: branching beyond axonal guidance and into immunity, PMCID:PMC3966552; Neuroimmune semaphorins as costimulatory molecules and beyond, PMCID:PMC6016892
primary_title: Intestinal epithelial cell-derived semaphorin 7A negatively regulates development of colitis via alphaVbeta1 integrin
decision_basis: The semaphorin reviews cite the primary intestinal study assigning epithelial SEMA7A-dependent macrophage IL-10 induction and protection from DSS colitis to alphaVbeta1 integrin.
limitations_preserved: Qualified at alphaVbeta1-dependent macrophage function; purified binary binding and a universal beta1-integrin mechanism are not claimed; preserve epithelial/macrophage and colitis context with no SCI inference.
